seo.title: Privacy Policy — Eternal Repos
seo.description: How Eternal Repos collects, uses and protects the information families and partners share with us, including our use of cookies and analytics.

privacy.heading: Privacy Policy

intro.before: This policy describes, in plain terms, how we handle the information you share with us. It is reviewed periodically; if you have questions it doesn’t answer, please write to us at

privacy.p1: Eternal Repos (“Eternal”, “we”, “us”) is operated by Consurgo Ventures Private Limited, registered at ATS Bouquet, Sector 132, Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201304, India. This policy applies to eternalrepos.com and to the enquiry, pre-booking, tribute and arrangement forms on this site.

whatWeCollect.heading: What we collect
whatWeCollect.p1: When you reach out to us — through an enquiry form, a pre-booking form, the “Arrange a Service” wizard, or a tribute submission — we collect what you choose to give us: your name, phone number, email address, and any details you share about the service you need (pickup and destination, dates, faith or tradition, and messages or notes). For a tribute submission, this may also include a photograph you upload.
whatWeCollect.p2: We do not ask for payment card details, government ID numbers, or medical records through this website.

howWeUseIt.heading: How we use it
howWeUseIt.p1: We use this information only to respond to your enquiry, coordinate the service you have asked for, and — where you have agreed — to follow up about pre-booking plans. We do not sell your information, and we do not use it for purposes unrelated to why you gave it to us.

cookies.heading: Cookies and analytics
cookies.p1: This site uses cookies for two purposes: to remember choices you make (such as your cookie preference itself), and — only if you accept — to understand how visitors use the site, via Google Analytics and Microsoft Clarity. These tools are not loaded until you accept cookies in the banner shown on your first visit; if you decline, no analytics cookies are set. You can change your choice at any time by clearing your browser’s site data for eternalrepos.com and revisiting the site.

whoElseSeesIt.heading: Who else sees it
whoElseSeesIt.p1: Enquiry and booking details are stored with Supabase, our database provider, which processes data on our behalf under its own security commitments. We do not share your information with advertisers or data brokers. We may disclose information if required by law.

retention.heading: How long we keep it
retention.p1: We retain enquiry and arrangement records for as long as needed to provide the service you requested and to meet our own record-keeping obligations, after which they are deleted or anonymised.

yourChoices.heading: Your choices
yourChoices.before: You can ask us to access, correct, or delete the personal information we hold about you by writing to
yourChoices.after: . We will respond as promptly as we can.

seo.title: Terms of Use — Eternal Repos
seo.description: The terms that govern your use of eternalrepos.com and any enquiry, pre-booking or arrangement you submit through it.

terms.heading: Terms of Use
terms.p1: This website, eternalrepos.com, is operated by Consurgo Ventures Private Limited (“Eternal”, “we”, “us”), registered at ATS Bouquet, Sector 132, Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201304, India. By using this site, you agree to these terms.

usingThisSite.heading: Using this site
usingThisSite.p1: You may browse this site and submit enquiry, pre-booking, arrangement or tribute forms for your own genuine use. You agree not to submit false information, attempt to disrupt the site, or use it to harm others.

notAutomaticBookings.heading: Enquiries and arrangements are not automatic bookings
notAutomaticBookings.p1: Submitting an enquiry, pre-booking form, or the “Arrange a Service” wizard registers your request with our team; it is not itself a confirmed booking. A member of our team will contact you to confirm availability, details and any applicable charges before a service is arranged. Prices shown anywhere on this site, including in the arrangement wizard, are indicative and may vary based on the specifics of your request.

contentAndIp.heading: Content and intellectual property
contentAndIp.p1: The text, images, logo and design of this site belong to Consurgo Ventures Private Limited or are used with permission. You may not copy, reproduce or reuse them for commercial purposes without our written consent.

thirdPartyLinks.heading: No liability for third-party links
thirdPartyLinks.p1: This site may link to third-party services (such as WhatsApp or our social media pages). We are not responsible for the content or practices of those third-party sites.

limitationOfLiability.heading: Limitation of liability
limitationOfLiability.p1: While we take care to keep this site accurate and available, we make no guarantee that it will be error-free or uninterrupted, and we are not liable for losses arising from your use of it, beyond what is required by applicable law.

changesToTerms.heading: Changes to these terms
changesToTerms.p1: We may update these terms from time to time; the date above reflects the latest revision. Continued use of the site after a change means you accept the updated terms.

governingLaw.heading: Governing law
governingLaw.p1: These terms are governed by the laws of India, and disputes are subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts at Gautam Buddh Nagar, Uttar Pradesh.
